title: He Calls Me by My Name
story: I Have Called You by Name
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
He told them of the road ahead,
The water and the flame;
But first He said, "Fear not, My child,
I know you by your name."

[Chorus]
He calls me by my name, by name,
He says, "You are My own";
And through the deepest water, still
I never walk alone.

[Verse 2]
The rivers will not wash me off,
The fire will not burn;
For He is right there in the deep,
At every twist and turn.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Beau stands upon the swimming stair,
His tummy flips around;
He hears his mama say his name,
And lets go at the sound.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So close your eyes, my little one,
And rest your sleepy head;
The One who called you by your name
Is right beside your bed.

[Chorus]
mood: Hand-holding music. A slow, even walk under the voice, one step into the water and then the next, never hurried, like a child being walked across a shallow river by someone who will not let go. Soft felt piano in slow, steady chords, with one low note held underneath them like a hand that stays. It grows a little surer with every verse, the fear gone by the last chorus.
